_comment: State the recorded conversation must leave behind. Asserted as a subset:
every field here must be present with this value, and the database may know
more. Only fields the recorded tool results revealed are asserted.
_key_columns declares how each table is addressed, so a row is identified by
a stable business key rather than by position in the snapshot.
The three mutations this conversation makes are a verification record scoped
to the open referral case, a referral-status tracker session issued against
RF8241, and an email notification telling the customer a secure message is
waiting. The referral itself is asserted unchanged: the reward has not
posted, the agent cannot make it post, and a run that quietly advanced the
qualification stage to close the call would fail here.
self_service_sessions.status is asserted as either value on purpose. Opening
the session happens in online banking, which no tool can observe, so the
handler writes 'issued' -> 'open_not_submitted' the first time the session is
read. Nothing requires that read: an agent that confirms the tracker it just
issued and one that does not have both handled the call correctly, and pinning
either value would make this assertion depend on the route after all.
